function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file in the working folder and return its contents.

path.description: File path, relative to the working folder.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List the names in one folder of the working folder. Not recursive. Names that start with . are hidden. Returns one name per line. Folder names end with /.

path.description: Folder path, relative to the working folder. Default is ".".

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace old_str with new_str in a file. old_str must match the file text exactly once. To create a new file, give an empty old_str and the full file text as new_str.

path.description: File path, relative to the working folder.

old_str.description: The exact text to replace. Empty to create a new file.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command in the working folder. Returns stdout, stderr, and the exit code. The command stops after 30 seconds.
